City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 9, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation for 2015 Encinitas Holiday Parade Grand Marshal Doug Long
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 10/28/15 Regular Meeting, 11/18/15 Special Meeting and 11/18/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-12-09 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-12-09 Item 8B - Warrants
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider: 1) The introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-16, which creates a voluntary mediation program for disputes over land use and development projects; 2) The adoption of Resolution No. 2015-58 that establishes a voluntary mediation program for general disputes, such as code enforcement issues, and authorizes the City Manager to enter into an agreement with the National Conflict Resolution Center for mediation services; and, 3) The adoption of Resolution 2015-78 that amends the Fiscal Year 2015-2016 Budget. Case Number: 15-174 POD. Contact Person: Senior Planner Strong
1) Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2) Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; 3) Introduce, with modifications as determined necessary, City Council Ordinance No. 2015-16 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Chapter 1.10 to the Encinitas Municipal Code to include provisions for a voluntary mediation program for land use and development projects" (Attachment "CC-1"); 4) Approve Resolution No. 2015-58 titled, "A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council establishing a voluntary mediation program for general disputes and authorizing the City Manager to enter into an agreement with National Conflict Resolution Center for mediation services" (Attachment "CC-2"); and, 5) Approve Resolution No. 2015-78 titled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget" (Attachment "CC-3") to fund a mediation program for general disputes.
2015-12-09 Item 10A - Public Hearing Mediation Program
10B.
Discussion and selection of the Deputy Mayor. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council to select one of its members as Deputy Mayor.
2015-12-09 Item 10B - Selection of Deputy Mayor
10C.
Review and Discussion of Appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards, Commissions, and Committees. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Receive the information.
2015-12-09 Item 10C - Council Committee Appointments
10D.
Discussion and Direction of City of Encinitas Legislative Program for 2016. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
1) Receive the report on year-end legislation; 2) Review the 2015 Legislative Program and provide staff with direction for any modifications; and, 3) Adopt the 2016 Legislative Program.
2015-12-09 Item 10D -Legislative Program for 2016
10E.
Review and discuss staffing report from Sheriff Captain Maryon, and consider Resolution 2015-85 amending the FY 2015-16 Law Enforcement budget. Contact Person: Sheriff Captain Maryon
1) Review and discuss the staffing report; and, 2) Approve Resolution No. 2015-85 amending the FY 2015-16 Law Enforcement budget.
2015-12-09 Item 10E - Sheriff Staffing Report
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
City Manager report pursuant to Encinitas Municipal Code Section 7.18.060 regarding the circumstances of purchases and work performed related to emergency slope repair along the east side of Highway 101.
The Memorandum dated December 2, 2015 containing the City Manager's determination of the emergency is provided as part of this agenda item.
A full report will be presented orally at this meeting for purposes of updating the City Council regarding the emergency.
2015-12-09 Item 11A - Emergency Slope Repair Memorandum
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-12-09 Item 15 - City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
